svg.title: File processing and retries
svg.desc: Ingest source; Wait in queue: Backlog stays queued; Parse and chunk; Enrich content: When configured; Build indexes; Searchable; Handle failure: Backoff / unblock / fix. source → queue; queue → parse; parse → enhance; enhance → index; index → ready; parse → error: Failure; enhance → error: Failure; index → error: Failure; error → queue: Retry
